code_blocks.instructor_explanation: the instructor is adding a language attribute to the SyntaxHighlighter component to ensure the code is properly formatted.
instructor applies the nightOwl style to make the code look better, comparing it to a VS Code theme.

code_blocks.content:
<SyntaxHighlighter language="javascript" style={nightOwl} customStyle={{margin: 0, borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: "11px", lineHeight: 1.4, height: "100%", border: "1px solid #3c3c3c"}}>
      {codeExamples[activeTab]}
    </SyntaxHighlighter>
code_blocks.instructor_explanation: instructor applies custom styling to the SyntaxHighlighter for improved visual presentation, including margin, border-radius, font-size, line-height, height, and border properties.
instructor creates a constant called floatingCards to store the configuration object for the UI cards, defining colors, icons, titles, and content for each tab.

code_blocks.content:
{floatingCards[activeTab].icon}
{floatingCards[activeTab].title}
{floatingCards[activeTab].content}
